description: Opera Neon through Opera's own installer, installed and never launched, found by the launcher it writes under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs.
why: The idle twin of 117, which launches the browser. Nothing is launched here: setup.ps1 fails on a process under the install directory, and forbid_rows holds that the launcher has no `proc` row. So the file row require_rows names, read by filesystem-windows.sql's per-user app branch, is the only witness. The Uninstall row is required with a space after the name: the key's name goes on past `Opera Neon`, which is why it is not the value. Nothing is forbidden: the install writes no catalogued agent's lookalike.
known_gaps: A match says Opera Neon is installed, not that Neon Do ran or a subscription is active: no route reads either.
Only the per-user install is read. A machine-wide one (the installer's --allusers=1) is not installed here, and a path outside a home is one no `~/` value names.
